chars: the young man with short brown hair
moments.action: In a brightly lit shop the young man leans in close, talking fast and earnest; the reverse cuts to the dark-haired young woman holding his gaze without answering, her face set and wary.

chars: the young man with short brown hair
moments.action: Cut to night: two cars sweep through a hairpin on a mountain road, and inside one of them she is at the wheel with him beside her. They blur past the lit city below and drop back into the trees.

chars: the young man with short brown hair
moments.action: Inside the car the framing tightens, from a windshield two-shot to both in profile with the road streaming past. Her hand closes on the gearshift and the cut goes back out to the two cars running the road.

chars: the young man with short brown hair
moments.action: She glances across at him with a small smile; he keeps his eyes forward. The camera then leaves the cabin for a silver car's tail-lights on wet tarmac and an aerial of three cars strung down the mountain.

chars: the young man with short brown hair
moments.action: Back through the windshield his half-smile breaks into open laughter; she laughs back with one hand loose on the wheel, and the guarded mood they carried out of the shop is gone.

chars: the young man with short brown hair
moments.action: The laughing settles into easy back-and-forth, cutting between her smiling at the road and him grinning across at her, until he says something that she answers properly rather than joking.

chars: the young man with short brown hair
moments.action: His grin fades and he looks away; a two-shot finds them side by side, her still smiling at the road, before he turns and just watches her, saying nothing.

chars: the young man with short brown hair
moments.action: One long held take: the pair sit framed through the windshield as the car keeps descending, then the camera lifts off them entirely and leaves the car as a lone light on the black mountain road.

chars: the young man with short brown hair
moments.action: Hard cut to daylight: a red coupe slides sideways across a concrete lot in its own tyre smoke, and the driver, the same young man, leans out of the window looking back along the line he just took.
